productsList.title: WorkingHours: Time Tracker, Timesheet
productsList.description:
Keep an accurate record of every workday, turn your hours into useful timesheets, and export them for billing or personal records. WorkingHours is a flexible time tracker and work log for freelancers, hourly workers, employees, contractors, consultants and self-employed professionals.

Start, pause and stop the timer as you work, or add entries manually. You can correct times anytime, record breaks, organize hours by task or project, and track rates, fees, overtime and earnings.

Track and organize your work
• Pause and resume the timer for breaks, with optional automatic break subtraction
• Automatically split work sessions that continue past midnight
• Add tasks, projects, tags, notes and descriptions
• Auto-assign tags to projects or new entries
• Record hourly rates and fixed lump-sum fees
• Adjust time or earnings with tag-based plus, minus, multiply or divide rules
• Search and filter entries to find the work you need

Turn tracked time into useful records
• Compare duration and revenue in charts and visual reports
• Export timesheets to Excel or CSV with your choice of columns
• Group exports by workday, week, month, task or tag
• Create PDF invoices from your WorkingHours data through SubTotal

Stay in control while you work
• Manage the timer from a mini window or overlay without opening the full app
• Use inactivity detection to catch time you may have forgotten to stop
• Run Pomodoro-style focus sessions for structured work intervals
• Continue your work log across supported phone, tablet, laptop and desktop versions with optional sync through your own cloud storage

Sync supports OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud and WebDAV. No WorkingHours account or registration is required.

WorkingHours is free to use. Some advanced features require WorkingHours Pro and can be tested with a 7-day trial after installation.

WorkingHours Pro is a one-time purchase linked to your Microsoft account and unlocks Pro access on Windows. A separate Pro purchase may be required on other platforms.

productsList.title: Calculator²
productsList.description:
Calculator² is the beautifully designed, all-in-one calculator app for students and professionals. The advanced scientific, financial and programmer calculators provide a comprehensive set of mathematical functions and constants to help you perform any type of calculation. The currency converter, with exchange rates updated in real-time, and unit converter offer 150+ World currencies and over 200 units respectively, with customisable favourites to allow you to save conversions for easy reference. Calculator² won't slow you down; the intuitive keyboard support allows you to simply type in functions to enter your calculations. With the incorporation of fluent design, Calculator² feels right at home on your Windows 10 desktop. The app is also available in the App Store and on Google Play, so you can enjoy the same the same great features across your PC and mobile devices.


Included:

Scientific Calculator
Programmer Calculator
Financial Calculator*
Basic Calculator
Currency Converter*
Unit Converter

* Unlocked with an in-app purchase. All other calculators are completely free!

Scientific Calculator

An advanced calculator with a comprehensive set of mathematical functions including trigonometric, hyperbolic, logarithmic, exponential, factorial, combination and permutation. Over 125 mathematical and physical constants are accessible in an easy-to-navigate list. Implicit multiplication and operator precedence are supported for faster input, while the unique memory mode provides a view applying statistics.

Programmer Calculator

A powerful tool for conversions between decimal, hexadecimal, octal and binary number bases, with a unique view for entering ASCII keys. Bitwise operations including AND, OR, XOR and NOT are available, in addition to functions not usually found in a programmer calculator, such as square and factorial.

Individual rates can be set for markup, discount, tax and interest. Perfect for students and professionals who wish to verify the results of time value of money calculations.

A simple, easy-to-use calculator for quick, everyday calculations.

Currency Converter

A comprehensive unit converter with over 200 units across 26 categories, including temperature, fuel consumption, viscosity, radiation and more.

productsList.title: Metre2 Mileage Tracker
productsList.description:
Logs business mileage for tax and expense claims for sole traders and freelancers, from a Windows
desktop app - date, purpose, from/to, vehicle and miles, one row per trip.

An always-visible tax-year dial sits above everything else: a radial gauge showing progress toward
the UK HMRC AMAP threshold (45p/mile for the first 10,000 business miles in a tax year, 25p after
by default - both editable), with business miles logged, claim value so far and your current
per-mile rate alongside it. Step back through past tax years with prev/next navigation. Every
trip's claim value is worked out automatically from your cumulative mileage that tax year - the
trip that tips you over the threshold has its value split correctly between the two rates, no
manual calculation needed.

The Log tab reads as a journal, not a spreadsheet - trips grouped by month, each one a compact
route line with purpose and vehicle tags, miles and value. "+ Log trip" opens a quick form for
date, purpose, from, to, vehicle and miles; the pencil icon on any entry opens the same form to
edit it. Search by purpose, from or to, filter by vehicle or purpose, or flip the newest/oldest
toggle, to find what you're looking for fast.

Switch to the Vehicles tab for a ranked leaderboard - miles, trips and claim value for each vehicle
you track, colour-coded and sorted by claim value. The Summary tab rolls the current log up into a
dashboard: total claim value as the headline figure, total miles, average trip, your most-used
vehicle, the date range covered, and a table of totals for every tax year you've logged trips in.

Trips persist between sessions, so the log is a running record that builds up over time. Your
currency symbol, mileage rates/threshold and vehicle list are all editable in Settings - defaults
match UK HMRC AMAP rates for cars and vans, but adjust them for other vehicle types or your own
figures.

When you need the record, export the whole log as a CSV file or a formatted PDF - for your own
files, an accountant, or a tax return.

The sample data leans towards trade and site work, but nothing enforces it - any sole trader or
freelancer who claims business mileage can use it.
